title: China Rose Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Vibrant Ornamental Foliage
description:
Add a spectacular splash of colour to your garden or home with 'China Rose' Coleus!
KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant burgundy leaves with a striking magenta centre
• Soft, downy foliage adds unique texture
• Perfect for beds, borders, and containers
• Can be grown outdoors in summer and indoors in winter
• Easy to grow and propagate
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides 'China Rose'
Colour: Burgundy with dark pink/magenta centre (foliage)
Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter (indoors)
Growth Habit: Bushy
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun to Partial shade
Soil: Chalk, Clay, Loam, Sand; Moist but well-drained, humus-rich
Watering: Regular watering, keeping soil evenly moist; more frequent for container plants in hot weather
Spacing: Approx. 30cm (12 inches) apart
Height: 0.1-0.5 metres
Spread: 0.1-0.5 metres
Hardiness: H1C (can be grown outside in summer, 5-10°C)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in well-drained, fertile soil, incorporating compost for heavy soils.
• Water regularly, especially in hot weather or when grown in containers; only water when the top 1-2 inches of soil are dry for garden beds.
• Pinch out tips of young plants to encourage a bushier growth habit.
• Remove flower stalks as they form to promote more vibrant foliage growth.
• If growing indoors, ensure bright, filtered light and maintain a minimum temperature of 10°C.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
